title: Australian Hibiscus — single-pixel PKL Full Reference resolution
purpose: Verify that the same source image, pixel coordinate and PKL master resolve to the same ATLAS reference identity after UI or implementation changes.

identity_policy.statement: Source pixel is observed RGB data. ATLAS result is the resolved PKL Full Reference identity.

comparison_context.note: Displayed hue values are comparison context only and must not be used as ground truth for ATLAS identity.

result_screenshot.scope: Documents the visible Image Picker result and expected ATLAS assignment.

pass_condition: All assertions match exactly when the original picker input image is sampled at x=512, y=161 against the same PKL master.
limitations: The evidence images are hash-bound but not embedded in this repository fixture.

The expected ATLAS assignment is verified against the documented Browser Bundle result; independent execution still requires the Image Picker implementation, the bound master and the hash-matching source image.
Displayed hue values in the source graphic remain non-normative comparison context.
